propositions: Maintenance scans (fsck and compact-all) iterate over all tickets including archived ones, causing O(all tickets) performance degradation as archived tickets accumulate and dominate walk time.
Archive operation (rebar archive) writes only ARCHIVED event and marker but does not fold, leaving archived tickets with unfolded tail events that require later compact-all walk to fold.

ticket list command already implements active-only default with --include-archived override using .archived marker fast-path and _is_net_archived confirmation; fsck and compact-all should reuse this same pattern.

Adding terminal fold to archive operation (inline before ARCHIVED event write, with threshold=0 and current-time horizon) ensures just-archived tickets have complete SNAPSHOTs covering all events without relying on later compact-all sweep.
fsck and compact-all commands need --include-archived flag to restore full walk (archived + active tickets) for deep audit and legacy pre-change archived-but-unfolded ticket folding.
